blocks.t: I]. HOW TO HANDLE AND MAINTAIN THIS MACHINE
1. Since the UNIVERSAL’s MR. DO! employs a color TV receiving set, be careful not to shake it during transit and when carrying it about.
Install it at a location which is not exposed to direct sunlight. In order to prevent the inside temperature rising, avoid as much as possible a location near a heater, etc.
Since the grounding terminal is visible, be sure to connect it to a grounding conductor.
Insert the power cord into the outlet and turn on the switch.
Even if the solid-state module seems to be out of order, do noi check the circuit by means of a circuit tester, etc., since the internal voltage of the tester, etc. nuy sometimes break down the IC.

Make sure the machine is well ventilated. If the tcmperature of the IC and transistor is lower than 60°C, the function normally and may be cons:.ier =, reliable. If it exceeds 60°C, their performance cannot be guaranteed.
Make sure that the connector, etc. are ro: aisconnected.
Whenever connecting the power cced of the solid-state module to, or disconnecting it from, the outlet, be sure to turn the power i.
Although the products u« l'NIVERSAL are manufactured with the utmost care, they may develop malfunctions when us2d for long periods. So, be sure to check this machine daily.

blocks.t: * This machine has a self-testor which locates any abnormalities with the machine should they occur.
Turn power ON while pressing the push-button or either the 1st or the 2nd player side, and self-testing will follow automatically.
(1) ROM Test: When normal — “ROM OK” will appear on the screen, «nc the test will proceed to the next step. When abnormal “ROM [J . CL ” will appear, anc the test will be suspended.
(2) RAM Test: When normal — ‘RAM OK” will apzeer on the screen, and the test will proceed to the next step. When abnormal “RAM oO "'v.'l appear, and the test will be suspended. Vat o-mal RAM No.

(3) Sound OFF: “SOUND OFF” will «zpeur on the screen, and the sound that has been made to that time will stop, then, the test will pvoceed to the next step. The machine is out of order if the sound does not stop or the test does not n-uveed to the next step.

(4) Switch Test: Switch ne:1es are displayed on the left side of the screen, while input conditions will be displayed on the right side. When the switch is ON, “0” is displayed for input, and when it is OFF, ‘1” is displayed. Conduct test while turning each switch ON-OFF — the test will advance to the next step after a minute. Switch name
“Q" will appear when pushing the pushbutton on the 1st player's side, COIN Right Left Not used 2P side pushbutton
(5) TV Monitor Test: Cross hatch pattern will appear on the entire screen. Monitor adjustrccm can be done by means of the pattern.
© Self-testing will stop at this point. Turn ON power again whe.. you want to resume game or execute self-test again.
* In case you have found any abnormality as a result cf the self-test, contact the dealer who sold the machine to you.

Two variable resistors, the +B ADJ VR (VR11 8-1K ohm) and the X-ray protector VR (VR8 B-10K ohms) are found within the monitor.
They are rigidly adhered for both safety and to prevent X-ray exposure from the CRT.
(IMPORTANT :Please do not remove or change them!)
When a component has to be replaced due to damage to the VR(s) please follow the fo’1ov ‘iig procedure when exchanging it.
(IMPORTANT: The monitor must be synchronized with the signal when adjustii'y.)
(1) To set for +B ADJ VR (VR11) +B line voltage is to be set at 107V DC +1V when adjusting VR11.
(2) To set for X-ray protector VR8
(2)-1. Place VR in a counter clockwise position to stop ‘t L°fore turning the monitor power switch to “ON” and decrease AC power supply voltag< 5y approximately 10%.
(2)-2. To be shorted for resistor of 220 ohms 20 *2u1 which is installed on heat sink plate.

(2)-3. Power supply should be placed in the “91!” position to keep the surface of the CRT slightly fluorescent — i.e. bright. (2)-4. +B line voltage is to be set at 12U DC+1V while increasing AC power supply voltage.

(2)-5. When the VRB to be fixed is ‘- the horizontal oscillation position it may be stopped by slowly rotating it clock wise. (2)-6. Once the power suj.p\v switch is turned “OFF” and AC power has decreased approximately t 10% it can be turneu “ON” again. Horizontal oscillation may then be confirmed by stopping +B line voltage c° 123V DC+1V while slowly increasing AC voltage.
(3) The VR must again be rigidly adhered thus making any further adjustments impossible.
